marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Wind west 10 to 15 knots veering to northwest 15 to 20 this
afternoon then increasing to northwest 25 to 30 this evening. Wind northwest 25
to 30 Tuesday. Showers changing to flurries Tuesday
morning. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 early Tuesday morning
then subsiding to 1 Tuesday evening.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:
Wednesday: Wind west 20 knots diminishing to light late
 in the day.<br/>Thursday: Wind light becoming northwest 10 to 15 knots
 late in the day.<br/>Friday: Wind northwest 10 to 15 knots becoming
